judgment.notes: There are no external E propositions. The complete parameter/H boundary preserves arbitrary prime p, arbitrary field K of characteristic p, integer 0≤l<p, complex V of dimension l+1, its irreducible Chevalley action, the chosen nonzero highest vector, and an arbitrary admissible M. Module.Finite accompanies finrank, so natural finrank is not being used to hide infinite dimension. H003's SimpleTriple is over ℂ on V; it does not assume the target property over K on VK. H005's integer basis also being a complex basis and stability under every divided-power generator are equivalent to the source admissibility conditions. No minimal lattice, algebraic closure, p>2 or l>0 is required. Checking helper dependency closures at the six source boundaries gives respectively {H002,H003,H004}, {H001,H002,H003,H005,N001}, {H001,H002,N001,N002}, {H001,H002,N001,N002,N003} plus freely available Mathlib, {H001,H002,N001,N002,N004}, and {H001,H002,H003,N005}. The revised T004 explicitly receives H004 as well as H002,T001,T003; its actual Lean binder supplies x v=0 for the zero-index endpoint. All conditional internal premises have identified earlier producers; none becomes a new project hypothesis.
